svg.text: Badi khabar aayi, meri feed me 20 minute baad
PEHLE: ek hi kaam me khabar laana bhi aur DB me likhna bhi
AB: fetcher sirf laaye, Kafka me daale, worker apni speed se likhe (Kafka)
PHIR? "Worker ne likha, Kafka commit se pehle crash. Dobara likha to?"
Bloom DB se alag cheez hai,
Bloom update se pehle crash ho gaya
dobara likha to bhi ek hi
